string.ConfigDescription: Product requirements and their delivery lifecycle
string.AcceptanceCriteriaPlaceholder: Describe how this requirement will be verified as done
string.SplitHint: Pick the work items to create. They are filed into the chosen project and each one links back to this requirement.
string.SplitProjectsUnavailable: The project list could not be read. Work items cannot be filed until this deployment's tracker is available.
string.SplitFrozen: This batch has been submitted. The project and the list are fixed. To pick it up again use Retry here — closing and re-opening starts a NEW batch and can create the same work items twice.
string.SplitSucceeded: {created, plural, =0 {No new work items} one {1 work item created} other {# work items created}}, {existing, plural, =0 {nothing existed before} one {1 already existed} other {# already existed}}.
string.SplitInProgress: The batch is still being created. Retry to pick it up — nothing is created twice.
string.SplitErrored: The request failed on the way. Retrying is safe: whatever was already created is not created again.
string.SplitUnavailable: This deployment cannot create work items from a requirement.
string.SplitReasonRequirementNotLatest: This is a superseded revision of the requirement. Split the current one.
string.SplitReasonProjectNotFound: The chosen project no longer exists.
string.SplitReasonTaskTypeNotFound: The chosen project has no issue type to file work items under.
string.SplitReasonNoItems: Name at least one work item.
string.SplitReasonIssueIdTaken: A work item of this batch collides with an existing document.
string.SplitReasonSequenceUnavailable: The project did not hand out an issue number.
string.SplitRefusedPartial: The batch stopped part way, and some of its work items may already exist. Retry here: this continues the same batch and never creates a duplicate. Do not close and re-open.
